questions.text: Describe a river, lake or sea that you have visited.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a river, lake or sea that you have visited. You should say: where it is; when you went there; what you did there; and explain how you felt about this place.
Thank you. Do many people go there?
